skills.name: kami
skills.description: Use when a user asks for a finished document whose appearance matters: a resume, one-pager, letter, portfolio, long report, slide deck, equity report, changelog, or a landing page. Kami fills a constrained parchment template and exports HTML to PDF, PNG, or editable PPTX, then verifies the result with deterministic and perceptual checks. Skip it when the user only wants the text.
